script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - MORNING

A cozy, quaint coffee shop in the heart of a picturesque small town. The aroma of freshly brewed coffee wafts through the air, mingling with the chatter of locals.

BEA (mid-20s, a curious, bright-eyed artist) sits alone at a table, sketchbook open before her. She looks up as the bell above the door rings, and in walks JOSH (mid-20s, rugged, charming small-town mechanic), wearing grease-stained overalls. They lock eyes, a brief, unspoken recognition passing between them.

BEA
(looking up)
Morning, Josh.

JOSH
(raising an eyebrow)
You remember my name?

Bea blushes, returning his gaze to her sketchbook.

BEA
I see you every day.

JOSH
(laughs)
Fair enough.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - LATER

The coffee shop empties as the day wears on. Bea and Josh sit at their usual table, sharing a pot of coffee and conversation.

BEA
I've always wanted to paint the town square. But I can't quite capture the feeling of it.

JOSH
Why not come with me sometime? I know every inch of this place. Maybe I can help you see it through my eyes.

Bea hesitates, then nods, a small smile playing at the corners of her mouth.

EXT. TOWN SQUARE - AFTERNOON

The sun casts golden rays across the town square as Bea and Josh explore, each discovering new details in the small-town surroundings.

BEA
(stops and turns to face Josh, her eyes alight with inspiration)
This is it. This is the feeling I've been trying to capture.

JOSH
(smiling)
I'm glad I could help.

INT. ART STUDIO - EVENING

Bea's art studio, cluttered with paintbrushes, canvases, and her sketchbook. She works tirelessly, fueled by her newfound inspiration.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - NIGHT

Josh enters the coffee shop, weary from a long day at the garage. He spots Bea, hunched over her sketchbook, and approaches.

JOSH
(placing a hand on her shoulder)
You're still here.

BEA
(looking up)
I couldn't leave until I finished this.

She shows him her latest work – a stunning, vibrant painting of the town square.

JOSH
(whispers)
It's beautiful, Bea.

BEA
(smiling)
Thank you, Josh.

INT. TOWN SQUARE - NIGHT

The town square comes alive as the sun sets, illuminated by twinkling fairy lights and the warm glow of lanterns. Bea and Josh stand in the midst of it, hand in hand.

BEA
(looking up at him)
I couldn't have done it without you.

JOSH
(smiling)
Then consider this our little secret.

They share a tender kiss, surrounded by the beauty of the small town they both call home.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
